aaron.title: Aaron
aaron.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
aaron.note: Moses's older brother, and the one God sent to do the talking when Moses said he could not. He became Israel's first high priest, and the priesthood ran through his sons after him. Most of the time he is standing next to Moses.

abiathar.title: Abiathar
abiathar.about: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
abiathar.note: He was the only priest to get out of Nob alive when Saul had the place killed, and he went straight to David and stayed his priest through the running years and the reign. At the end he backed Adonijah instead of Solomon, and Solomon sent him away from the priesthood rather than kill him.

abiezer.title: Abiezer
abiezer.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
abiezer.note: A warrior from the united-kingdom years who carries the clan's name. Nothing links him to Gideon's family beyond the spelling.

abihu.title: Abihu
abihu.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
abihu.note: Aaron's second son. He and his brother Nadab brought fire the Lord had not asked for and died on the spot, and Aaron was not allowed to mourn them in public.

abijah-3.title: Abijah
abijah-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
abijah-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

abner.title: Abner
abner.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
abner.note: Saul's cousin, and the commander of his army. When Saul died he did not stop: he kept the war going between David and what was left of Saul's house.

abraham.title: Abraham
abraham.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
abraham.note: God called him out of Ur and he went at seventy-five, which is most of what you need to know about him. The nation came out of that.

adiel.title: Adiel
adiel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
adiel.note: Father of one of David's treasury officials, and that is his whole appearance in the record.

adlai.title: Adlai
adlai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
adlai.note: Father of Shaphat, the man who looked after David's cattle out in the valleys. That is his whole appearance.

ahijah-4.title: Ahijah
ahijah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahijah-4.note: One of 8 men called Ahijah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ahimelech-2.title: Ahimelech
ahimelech-2.about: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
ahimelech-2.note: A priest in David's time, named in the list at 2 Samuel 8:17 and in the priestly divisions of 1 Chronicles 24. He is not the priest of Nob, who belongs to Saul's years.

ahithophel.title: Ahithophel
ahithophel.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
ahithophel.note: David's most trusted counsellor, whose advice was treated as if it came from God. He went over to Absalom. When Absalom turned down his plan for a rival counsellor's, Ahithophel saw the rebellion was finished, went home, put his affairs in order and hanged himself.

ahohite.title: Ahohite
ahohite.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ahohite.note: Three of David's fighting men carry this label, marking them as descendants of Ahoah: Dodo, his son Eleazar, who was among the three mightiest, and Zalmon of the thirty.

amariah-2.title: Amariah
amariah-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
amariah-2.note: A levite from the wilderness years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

ammiel-2.title: Ammiel
ammiel-2.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
ammiel-2.note: One of 3 men called Ammiel. This one is a Levite from the united kingdom, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ammizabad.title: Ammizabad
ammizabad.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ammizabad.note: Benaiah commanded the third division of David's army, and his son Ammizabad appears to have run it on his behalf.

amram.title: Amram
amram.about: Moses' father living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
amram.note: The father of Aaron, Moses and Miriam. He was a Levite and married his father's sister Jochebed, and beyond that little is recorded about him.

amramite.title: Amramite
amramite.about: Moses' father living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
amramite.note: Descendants of Amram, the son of Kohath and father of Moses, Aaron and Miriam. Under David, men of this family helped oversee the treasuries of gifts dedicated for the temple.

archi.title: Archi
archi.note: Hushai's clan. He was the loyal friend of David who worked against Ahithophel's advice during Absalom's rebellion.

asahel.title: Asahel
asahel.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
asahel.note: Joab's younger brother, one of David's best warriors and famous for his speed. He died chasing Abner in the fighting between David's side and Saul's. Joab later murdered Abner for it, and that killing hung over David's reign.

asaph.title: Asaph
asaph.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asaph.note: A Levite David put in charge of one of the temple choirs. Twelve psalms carry his name, Psalm 50 and Psalms 73 to 83, which means either he wrote them or a guild of musicians kept his name for generations.

asarelah.title: Asarelah
asarelah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asarelah.note: One of Asaph's sons whom David appointed to prophesy with harp and cymbals. Later in the same chapter he is Jesharelah.

azarael-6.title: Azarael
azarael-6.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azarael-6.note: Chronicles names him once, among David's musicians and officers.

azarael-3.title: Azarael
azarael-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azarael-3.note: One of 6 men called Azarael. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

azaziah-2.title: Azaziah
azaziah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azaziah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

azmaveth-4.title: Azmaveth
azmaveth-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azmaveth-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

azriel.title: Azriel
azriel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azriel.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

baal-hanan-2.title: Baal-hanan
baal-hanan-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
baal-hanan-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

beer-shebah.title: Beer-shebah
beer-shebah.note: From Dan to Beersheba meant all of Israel, top to bottom, and this was the bottom. It marked the southern edge of Judah's land and went first to Simeon. Genesis gives two separate stories for how it got its name.

benaiah-5.title: Benaiah
benaiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
benaiah-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

benaiah.title: Benaiah
benaiah.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
benaiah.note: He commanded David's bodyguard, and before that he was known for killing a lion in a pit on a snowy day. He also beat an Egyptian giant by wrestling the giant's own spear off him and killing him with it.

benaiah-3.title: Benaiah
benaiah-3.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
benaiah-3.note: Not the captain of the bodyguard but another of David's warriors with the same name. He turns up in 2 Samuel 23:30 and twice in Chronicles.

benjamin.title: Benjamin
benjamin.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
benjamin.note: Jacob's twelfth son and the youngest, born to Rachel on the road near Bethlehem as she died giving birth to him. Jacob guarded him fiercely after losing Joseph. That fear drives much of the tension in Joseph's story.

beriah-2.title: Beriah
beriah-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
beriah-2.note: One of 4 men called Beriah. This one is a Levite from the wilderness years, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

bilgah-2.title: Bilgah
bilgah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bilgah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

bukkiah.title: Bukkiah
bukkiah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bukkiah.note: Heman's son, a Kohathite Levite. He led one of the divisions of temple musicians set up under David.

chelub.title: Chelub
chelub.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
chelub.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

chenaniah.title: Chenaniah
chenaniah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
chenaniah.note: David put this Levite in charge of the music when the ark was brought up to Jerusalem, because he was good at it.

dalaiah-3.title: Dalaiah
dalaiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
dalaiah-3.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

dan.title: Dan
dan.note: The tribe of Dan and the town it took. Squeezed in its first allotment near the Philistines, the tribe went north, captured Laish and renamed it Dan, Israel's northernmost town and the far end of from Dan to Beersheba. Jeroboam I put one of his golden calves there, and a stele from Tel Dan found in 1993 names the House of David.

david.title: David
david.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
david.note: The shepherd from Bethlehem who killed Goliath and became Israel's second king, ruling a kingdom bigger than any native king held before or after. Solomon was one of his sons. Nearly half the psalms carry his name, and the Tel Dan inscription, where an enemy king boasts over the house of David, put his dynasty outside the Bible as well.

dodai.title: Dodai
dodai.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
dodai.note: An Ahohite who led David's army division in the second month, one of twelve divisions that took turns. He may be the father of Eleazar, one of David's three chief warriors.

edar.title: Edar
edar.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
edar.note: A Levite, named twice in the Levite rolls of 1 Chronicles 23 and 24. The tower of Eder near Bethlehem, where Jacob camped after Rachel died, shares the name and nothing more.

elam-4.title: Elam
elam-4.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elam-4.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

eleazar.title: Eleazar
eleazar.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eleazar.note: Aaron's third son. Nadab and Abihu died for offering unauthorized fire, and Eleazar became high priest after his father. He worked with Moses on the second census and with Joshua on dividing the land, and his line held the high priesthood for most of the history after.

eleazar-2.title: Eleazar
eleazar-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eleazar-2.note: A Levite in the Chronicles lists, a different man from Aaron's son the high priest.

eliashib-4.title: Eliashib
eliashib-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliashib-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

eliathah.title: Eliathah
eliathah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliathah.note: A son of Heman, the Levite musician of David's court, and head of one of the divisions of temple musicians.

eliezer.title: Eliezer
eliezer.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eliezer.note: Moses's second son. The name means my God is my help, and his descendants are counted among the Levites in Chronicles.

eliezer-3.title: Eliezer
eliezer-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
eliezer-3.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

elihoenai-2.title: Elihoenai
elihoenai-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elihoenai-2.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

elihu-4.title: Elihu
elihu-4.about: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
elihu-4.note: A man from the united kingdom. 1 Chronicles names him once.

elihu-3.title: Elihu
elihu-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elihu-3.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

elzabad-2.title: Elzabad
elzabad-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
elzabad-2.note: A son of Shemaiah, counted among the able men of his family of gatekeepers.

ephraim.title: Ephraim
ephraim.about: Joseph's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
ephraim.note: Joseph's younger son. When Jacob blessed the two boys he crossed his hands on purpose and gave Ephraim the bigger blessing over Manasseh. The tribe came to dominate the north so much that the prophets use Ephraim for the whole northern kingdom.

ezri.title: Ezri
ezri.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ezri.note: He was Chelub's son, and David put him over the workers who farmed the royal land; that one line in Chronicles is the whole of him.

gad-2.title: Gad
gad-2.about: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
gad-2.note: A prophet of the united monarchy, and nothing to do with Jacob's son. He first turns up in 1 Samuel 22:5, comes back in 2 Samuel 24, and Chronicles names him again.

gamul.title: Gamul
gamul.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
gamul.note: The twenty-second of the twenty-four priestly divisions David set up for the temple went by his name.

gedaliah-2.title: Gedaliah
gedaliah-2.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
gedaliah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a Levite from the united kingdom.

gederite.title: Gederite
gederite.note: Baal-hanan, who looked after David's olive and sycamore trees in the lowlands, is called this because he came from Geder or Gederah.

gershom.title: Gershom
gershom.note: These verses are the census ones, Genesis 46:11, Exodus 6:16 and Numbers 3 and 4, where his family is counted and given its share of the tabernacle work. The note filed with them describes Moses's firstborn, born in Midian and named for a stranger there, who is a different man.

gershon.title: Gershon
gershon.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
gershon.note: Levi's eldest son. His descendants carried the tabernacle's coverings, curtains and hangings by cart through the wilderness. Exodus 2:22 and 18:3, filed under this name, belong to a different man.

gibeon.title: Gibeon
gibeon.note: They tricked Joshua into a treaty by dressing as travellers from far away, the Hivites of this city northwest of Jerusalem, and so they lived but served at Israel's sanctuary. The tabernacle stood at Gibeon for years, and Solomon had his dream there. At el-Jib dozens of jar handles stamped with the name have settled where it was.

giddalti.title: Giddalti
giddalti.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
giddalti.note: One of Heman's sons, and Heman was a Levite musician in David's court. Giddalti led one of the twenty-four divisions of temple musicians.

gilead.title: Gilead
gilead.note: Hill country east of the Jordan, split by the Jabbok between Og in the north and Sihon in the south before the conquest. Gad, Reuben and half of Manasseh got it, and its rough ground made it a refuge for Jacob running from Laban and David running from Absalom. Jeremiah's question about balm in Gilead comes from its trade in balm and spices.

hachmoni.title: Hachmoni
hachmoni.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hachmoni.note: The Hachmonite family name stands behind Jashobeam, one of David's chief warriors, and Jehiel, who attended David's sons, is called his son.

hagarene.title: Hagarene
hagarene.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hagarene.note: They were nomads east of Gilead, beaten by Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh in a war Chronicles records.

hanani-2.title: Hanani
hanani-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hanani-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

hananiah-3.title: Hananiah
hananiah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hananiah-3.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

happizzez.title: Happizzez
happizzez.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
happizzez.note: Head of the eighteenth of the twenty-four priestly divisions, chosen by lot. Some English versions spell it Aphses, and nothing else is recorded of him.

haran-4.title: Haran
haran-4.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
haran-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

harim.title: Harim
harim.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
harim.note: The third priestly course in 1 Chronicles 24:8 went by this name, and the family came back from exile. Some of them were among the men Ezra confronted for marrying foreign wives.

hashabiah-2.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-2.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
hashabiah-2.note: One of 10 men called Hashabiah. This one is a Levite from the united kingdom, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

hashabiah-4.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hashabiah-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

hashabiah-5.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hashabiah-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

haziel.title: Haziel
haziel.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
haziel.note: He was a Gershonite Levite, through Shimei, in the lists David drew up for temple service.

hebron.title: Hebron
hebron.note: Abraham camped near here at Mamre and bought the cave of Machpelah to bury Sarah. It sits in the hill country south of Jerusalem, once called Kirjath-arba, and Joshua gave it to Caleb. David reigned there seven years before moving to Jerusalem, and Herod's great stone enclosure over the traditional tomb still stands.

hebron-2.title: Hebron
hebron-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hebron-2.note: Kohath's son, a Levite, and a clan of Levites came from him.

hebronites.title: Hebronites
hebronites.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hebronites.note: They were Levites of Kohath's line, through his son Hebron. Under David they were put over Israelite land west of the Jordan and over treasuries tied to the temple.

heldai-2.title: Heldai
heldai-2.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
heldai-2.note: Two men. One was over David's army in the twelfth month, a Netophathite. The other came back from Babylon with gold and silver, and Zechariah was told to make a crown from it for Joshua the high priest.

helez.title: Helez
helez.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy

heman.title: Heman
heman.about: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
heman.note: David put him among the chief musicians over the worship, a Levite. Psalm 88, one of the darkest laments in the book, is credited to him.

hezir.title: Hezir
hezir.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hezir.note: Head of the seventeenth of the priestly divisions David set up for temple service. A first-century BC tomb in the Kidron Valley names a priestly family called the Sons of Hezir, so the name stayed in Jerusalem's priesthood a long time.

hillkiah-4.title: Hillkiah
hillkiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hillkiah-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

hosah.title: Hosah
hosah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hosah.note: A Levite of Merari's family whom David made a gatekeeper, and his family kept the post after him.

hoshea.title: Hoshea
hoshea.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hoshea.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

hothir.title: Hothir
hothir.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hothir.note: Heman had fourteen sons, and Hothir was one of them. Heman was David's seer and a lead Levite musician, and Hothir led one of the divisions of temple musicians chosen by lot.

huppah.title: Huppah
huppah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
huppah.note: In David's reign the priests served by rota, and Huppah headed the thirteenth of the twenty-four divisions.

hushai.title: Hushai
hushai.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
hushai.note: David's friend, who stayed behind when Absalom rebelled so he could work from inside Absalom's court. Ahithophel gave Absalom sound advice, Hushai talked him into a worse plan, and the time it bought saved David.

hushathite.title: Hushathite
hushathite.note: Two of David's mighty men carry this label, Sibbecai and Mebunnai, and it ties them to Hushah in Judah's genealogy. Sibbecai is also the one who killed a Philistine giant in a later battle at Gob.

ibri.title: Ibri
ibri.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ibri.note: A Merarite Levite of Jaaziah's family, in the Levitical divisions of David's time. Nothing further is recorded about him.

iddo-4.title: Iddo
iddo-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
iddo-4.note: Named once, in a list of tribal officers in Chronicles, and that is all the record holds.

ikkesh.title: Ikkesh
ikkesh.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ikkesh.note: His son Ira, from Tekoa, was one of David's mighty warriors.

immer.title: Immer
immer.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
immer.note: Head of one of David's twenty-four priestly divisions, and his family name comes back with the returning exiles.

ira.title: Ira
ira.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
ira.note: One of David's elite warriors, who in Chronicles also commands one of the monthly army divisions. Ira was the name of more than one of David's men.

isaac.title: Isaac
isaac.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
isaac.note: Abraham and Sarah's promised son, born when his father was a hundred. God told Abraham to sacrifice him on Mount Moriah and provided a ram at the last moment. Old and blind, he was tricked by Jacob into giving him Esau's blessing, and he never left Canaan or took a second wife.

isaiah.title: Isaiah
isaiah.about: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
isaiah.note: Amoz's son, a prophet in Jerusalem in the eighth century, who counselled four kings of Judah and is quoted in the New Testament more than any other prophet. He gave his two sons names that were sermons, Shear-jashub and Maher-shalal-hash-baz. When Sennacherib besieged Jerusalem he told Hezekiah the city would stand, and the Taylor Prism brags of the siege without ever claiming the city fell.

ishiah-3.title: Ishiah
ishiah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishiah-3.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

ishiah.title: Ishiah
ishiah.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ishiah.note: A Levite in the lists of temple divisions, named twice in Chronicles. Isshiah was a common Levitical name.

ishmaelite.title: Ishmaelite
ishmaelite.about: Abraham's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
ishmaelite.note: The Ishmaelites came from Abraham's son Ishmael and traded across the country south and east of Canaan. One of their caravans bought Joseph from his brothers and took him down to Egypt.

ishmaiah-2.title: Ishmaiah
ishmaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishmaiah-2.note: A ruler over Zebulun in David's organisation of the tribes.

israel.title: Israel
israel.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
israel.note: God gave Jacob this name after he wrestled through the night at Peniel. It became the name of the nation that came from his twelve sons, and later of the northern kingdom and of the land. For the man himself, see Jacob.

issachar.title: Issachar
issachar.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
issachar.note: Jacob's ninth son. His tribe held the fertile Jezreel Valley, and Chronicles says its men understood the times and knew what Israel ought to do.

issachar-2.title: Issachar
issachar-2.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
issachar-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the united kingdom.

ithamar.title: Ithamar
ithamar.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ithamar.note: Aaron's youngest son. Two of his brothers died for offering unauthorized fire and Eleazar became high priest, and Ithamar was put over the Levites who carried and kept the tabernacle. Eli came from his line, which held the high priesthood for a while before it went back to Eleazar's line under Zadok.

izeharites.title: Izeharites
izeharites.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
izeharites.note: The family of Izhar, Kohath's son. Korah came from them, the Levite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron and was swallowed by the earth.

izhar.title: Izhar
izhar.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
izhar.note: He was Kohath's son, and his own son Korah led the rebellion against Moses in the wilderness.

izrahite.title: Izrahite
izrahite.about: Judah's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
izrahite.note: The label on Shamhuth, who commanded David's division for the fifth month. It most likely means he came from Zerah, Judah's son.

jaasiel-2.title: Jaasiel
jaasiel-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
jaasiel-2.note: Son of Abner, and chief officer over Benjamin in David's administration.

jaazer.title: Jaazer
jaazer.note: Jazer, an Amorite town in Gilead east of the Jordan. Israel took it and gave it to Gad, then to the Levites of Merari. Isaiah and Jeremiah both use its ruined vineyards as a picture of Moab's ruin.

jaaziah.title: Jaaziah
jaaziah.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jaaziah.note: One of Merari's descendants, listed when David set the Levites into divisions for temple service.

jachin-4.title: Jachin
jachin-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jachin-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

jahath-2.title: Jahath
jahath-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jahath-2.note: One of 4 men called Jahath. This one is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jahath.title: Jahath
jahath.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahath.note: A Levite of Gershon's line in Chronicles. The name comes up often in the Levite genealogies, for men of both Gershon and Kohath.

jahaziel.title: Jahaziel
jahaziel.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahaziel.note: A Levite named twice in the Chronicles lists of Levite families, and nothing more is told of him. Another Jahaziel prophesied to Jehoshaphat.

jakim.title: Jakim
jakim.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jakim.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jashobeam.title: Jashobeam
jashobeam.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jashobeam.note: Chief of David's three greatest warriors, credited with killing three hundred men in one fight.

jathniel.title: Jathniel
jathniel.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jathniel.note: Meshelemiah's fourth son, a Korahite Levite, and one of the gatekeepers at the temple's entrances under David.

jaziz.title: Jaziz
jaziz.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaziz.note: King David's flocks were his to look after, and he was a Hagrite.

jedaiah-2.title: Jedaiah
jedaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jedaiah-2.note: The second priestly division in Chronicles carries his name, and his descendants are counted among the priests who came back from Babylon.

jediael-4.title: Jediael
jediael-4.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jediael-4.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

jeduthun.title: Jeduthun
jeduthun.about: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
jeduthun.note: David put three chief musicians over temple worship, Heman, Asaph and Jeduthun. Several psalms carry Jeduthun's name in their headings.

jehdeiah.title: Jehdeiah
jehdeiah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehdeiah.note: A Levite from Shubael's line, given a division of temple service under David. Another Jehdeiah, a Meronothite, looked after the royal donkeys.

jehdeiah-2.title: Jehdeiah
jehdeiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehdeiah-2.note: He looks after the donkeys on the royal estates. The other Jehdeiah is a Levite in David's temple rota.

jehiel-3.title: Jehiel
jehiel-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehiel-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

jehiel-4.title: Jehiel
jehiel-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehiel-4.note: One of 10 men called Jehiel. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jehieli.title: Jehieli
jehieli.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehieli.note: A Gershonite Levite from Ladan's line. He and his brother Zetham kept the temple treasuries under David, the gifts and spoils set aside for the house of the LORD, and nothing further is recorded about him.

jehohanan.title: Jehohanan
jehohanan.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehohanan.note: A gatekeeper at the temple under David. The name was common, and one man of it led troops under Jehoshaphat.

jehoiada-2.title: Jehoiada
jehoiada-2.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
jehoiada-2.note: Known through his son, the commander of David's bodyguard who carried out the killings after David's death, in Samuel and Kings.

jehoiada-4.title: Jehoiada
jehoiada-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehoiada-4.note: One of 4 men called Jehoiada. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jehoiarib.title: Jehoiarib
jehoiarib.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehoiarib.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jehozabad-2.title: Jehozabad
jehozabad-2.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
jehozabad-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the united kingdom.

jehush-2.title: Jehush
jehush-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jehush-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a Levite from the wilderness years.

jekameam.title: Jekameam
jekameam.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jekameam.note: Hebron's fourth son, in the Kohathite line of Levites, and the head of one of the Levitical divisions set up for temple service under David.

jerahmeel-2.title: Jerahmeel
jerahmeel-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jerahmeel-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

jeriah.title: Jeriah
jeriah.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jeriah.note: Head of the Hebronite clan of Levites under David, and put in charge of the king's business east of the Jordan.

jerijah.title: Jerijah
jerijah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jerijah.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jermoth-3.title: Jermoth
jermoth-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jermoth-3.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

jermoth-2.title: Jermoth
jermoth-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jermoth-2.note: One of 7 men called Jermoth. This one is a Levite from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jermoth-4.title: Jermoth
jermoth-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jermoth-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

jeroham-4.title: Jeroham
jeroham-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeroham-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jerusalem.title: Jerusalem
jerusalem.note: David took it from the Jebusites and made it his capital, and once Solomon's temple stood there it was the centre of Israel's worship for a thousand years. Babylon destroyed it, the exiles rebuilt it, Rome destroyed it again in AD 70. Jesus died and rose just outside its walls, and Revelation ends with a new Jerusalem coming down from heaven.

jesharelah.title: Jesharelah
jesharelah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jesharelah.note: Asaph's son, spelled Asarelah elsewhere, at the head of the seventh of David's twenty-four divisions of temple musicians.

jeshebeab.title: Jeshebeab
jeshebeab.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeshebeab.note: The fourteenth turn of the twenty-four, when David set the priests on a rota, fell to his house.

jeshua-2.title: Jeshua
jeshua-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeshua-2.note: One of the priestly houses, in the temple rota of Chronicles and again among the priests who came back from Babylon in Ezra and Nehemiah.

jesse.title: Jesse
jesse.about: David's father living at the time of United Monarchy
jesse.note: Obed's son and Boaz and Ruth's grandson, a man of some standing in Bethlehem with eight sons, the youngest David. Isaiah's "stem of Jesse" is David's family, and the "root of Jesse" is the Messiah. The last we see of him, David is getting him a safe place with the king of Moab.

jezerites.title: Jezerites
jezerites.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jezerites.note: The fourth of twenty-four divisions of temple singers under Asaph, the turn falling by lot to Izri, whose name is elsewhere spelled Zeri.

joab.title: Joab
joab.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
joab.note: David's nephew, and the commander of his army for most of the reign. He was loyal to what David needed rather than what David said: he arranged Uriah's death when asked, killed Absalom when told not to, and murdered Abner and Amasa under cover of friendship. David never forgave Absalom. On David's word Solomon had Joab killed, even holding on to the altar.

joah-2.title: Joah
joah-2.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
joah-2.note: One of 5 men called Joah. This one is a Levite from the united kingdom, named once in 1 Chronicles.

joash-6.title: Joash
joash-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joash-6.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years. The verse is 1 Chronicles 27:28.

joel-3.title: Joel
joel-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joel-3.note: One of 14 men called Joel. This one is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

joel-6.title: Joel
joel-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joel-6.note: One of 14 men called Joel. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles. The verse is 1 Chronicles 27:20.

jonathan.title: Jonathan
jonathan.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
jonathan.note: Saul's eldest son, heir to the throne, and David's friend. He made a covenant with David knowing it cost him the crown. Once, with only his armour-bearer, he climbed a cliff and started a rout of the Philistine army. He died with Saul and two brothers on Mount Gilboa, and David's lament for him says his love was "surpassing the love of women."

jonathan-6.title: Jonathan
jonathan-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jonathan-6.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

joram-2.title: Joram
joram-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joram-2.note: One of 3 men called Joram. This one is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jordan.title: Jordan
jordan.note: It runs from the slopes of Mount Hermon through the Sea of Galilee and down the Rift Valley to the Dead Sea, about sixty five miles in a straight line and nearer two hundred as the river winds. Israel crossed it on dry ground under Joshua, Elijah and Elisha each parted it, and John the Baptist baptised Jesus in it.

joseph-4.title: Joseph
joseph-4.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joseph-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

joshbekashah.title: Joshbekashah
joshbekashah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joshbekashah.note: Heman, David's seer, had a son by this name, and the seventeenth of the twenty-four courses of temple musicians was his.

judah.title: Judah
judah.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
judah.note: Leah's fourth son, and the brother who ends up leading. He talked the others into selling Joseph rather than killing him, and later offered himself as a hostage in Benjamin's place. His tribe produced David's royal line and gave its name to the southern kingdom, and Jacob's dying blessing promised the sceptre would not leave him.

kemuel.title: Kemuel
kemuel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
kemuel.note: One of 3 men called Kemuel. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

kish-2.title: Kish
kish-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
kish-2.note: He is a Levite, not Saul's father. His sons married their cousins because their uncle died with only daughters, and the temple rota in Chronicles counts his family.

kish.title: Kish
kish.about: Saul's father living at the time of United Monarchy
kish.note: Saul's father, a Benjamite of some standing. He lost his donkeys, sent Saul to find them, and the search ended with Samuel anointing Saul as Israel's first king.

kohath.title: Kohath
kohath.about: Levi's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
kohath.note: Levi's second son. His descendants had the holiest work in the tabernacle, carrying the ark and the sacred furniture on poles, and even they would die if they touched those things.

kore.title: Kore
kore.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
kore.note: There was a family of temple gatekeepers who traced themselves to him, and Chronicles names him at the head of their line.

koz.title: Koz
koz.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
koz.note: Ancestor of a priestly family that came back from exile and could not prove its descent, and until that was settled they were kept out of the priesthood.

laadan.title: Laadan
laadan.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
laadan.note: One of the founders of the Gershonite Levite families in Chronicles, though a man of Ephraim has the name too.

lasharon.title: Lasharon
lasharon.note: "Belonging to Sharon." Joshua beat a king of Lasharon, but most of these verses are about the Sharon plain, the rich coast between Joppa and Mount Carmel, with royal pasture and some of Gad living there. Its beauty became a byword, "the rose of Sharon," and Isaiah pictures it blooming again.

levi.title: Levi
levi.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
levi.note: Jacob's third son. He and Simeon massacred the men of Shechem after their sister Dinah was raped, and Jacob cursed them both for it on his deathbed. Even so, Levi's descendants became Israel's priestly tribe, given service at the tabernacle instead of land, partly for their zeal against the golden calf at Sinai.

leviite.title: Leviite
leviite.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
leviite.note: An old spelling of Levite, found in a few manuscripts and translations for the tribe of Levi.

maachah-8.title: Maachah
maachah-8.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
maachah-8.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

maaziah.title: Maaziah
maaziah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
maaziah.note: The twenty-fourth and last of David's priestly divisions was his. A later priest of the same name put his seal on Nehemiah's covenant.

maharai.title: Maharai
maharai.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
maharai.note: From Netophah, one of David's mighty warriors, and later the commander of one of David's monthly army divisions.

mahazioth.title: Mahazioth
mahazioth.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mahazioth.note: Heman's son, one of the Kohathite Levites David set over the temple music. He led the twenty-third of the twenty-four courses. His name means "visions," which suits a family whose playing was called prophesying.

mahli.title: Mahli
mahli.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
mahli.note: Merari's son and Levi's grandson. His family became one of the Levitical clans with work at the tabernacle.

mahli-2.title: Mahli
mahli-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
mahli-2.note: A second Mahli, under Merari's line in the Levite lists of Chronicles, and nothing more is known of him.

malchijah-2.title: Malchijah
malchijah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
malchijah-2.note: One of 12 men called Malchijah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

mallothi.title: Mallothi
mallothi.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mallothi.note: Heman's son, one of the Levite musicians David appointed, and the lot made him head of the nineteenth of twenty-four divisions.

manasseh.title: Manasseh
manasseh.about: Joseph's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
manasseh.note: Joseph's elder son, whom Jacob took as his own and blessed. His name went to one of Israel's twelve tribes, and from Numbers through Joshua and Chronicles most of his verses are about that tribe and its land.

mattaniah-2.title: Mattaniah
mattaniah-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mattaniah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

mattithiah-n.title: Mattithiah. n
mattithiah-n.about: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
mattithiah-n.note: A Levitical name, carried by several of the singers and gatekeepers David appointed.

merari.title: Merari
merari.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
merari.note: Levi's third son. His descendants had the heavy parts of the tabernacle, the frames, bars, pillars and bases, which went by cart instead of being carried.

meronothite.title: Meronothite
meronothite.note: From Meronoth, wherever that was. Jehdeiah the Meronothite kept David's donkeys, and generations later Jadon the Meronothite helped repair Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.

meshelemiah.title: Meshelemiah
meshelemiah.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
meshelemiah.note: Head of a family of temple gatekeepers under David. The lot gave him the east gate, a post with some honour to it.

miamin-2.title: Miamin
miamin-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
miamin-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

micah-3.title: Micah
micah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
micah-3.note: A Levite, head of a family in the divisions of 1 Chronicles 23 and 24, and nothing more is known.

michael-3.title: Michael
michael-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
michael-3.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

mikloth-2.title: Mikloth
mikloth-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mikloth-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

moses.title: Moses
moses.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
moses.note: Born a Hebrew slave in Egypt and raised in Pharaoh's house, he killed an Egyptian overseer and ran to Midian, where he kept sheep for forty years. God called him back from the burning bush to face Pharaoh and lead Israel out. He gave them the law at Sinai, led them forty years in the wilderness, and died at a hundred and twenty within sight of the promised land.

mushi.title: Mushi
mushi.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
mushi.note: Merari's son and Levi's grandson. His family became one of the Levitical clans serving at the tabernacle.

nadab.title: Nadab
nadab.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
nadab.note: Aaron's eldest son. He and his brother Abihu offered unauthorised fire before the Lord and were struck dead.

naphtali.title: Naphtali
naphtali.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
naphtali.note: Jacob's sixth son, born to Rachel's servant Bilhah. His tribe settled in northern Galilee, the land Isaiah says will see a great light, and Matthew ties that to Jesus starting his work there.

nathan.title: Nathan
nathan.about: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
nathan.note: The prophet who told David the story of the rich man who took a poor man's only lamb, let David condemn the man, and then turned it on him over Bathsheba and Uriah. Earlier he had brought God's promise that David's house would last forever. When David was dying, Nathan helped put Solomon on the throne ahead of a rival half-brother.

ner.title: Ner
ner.about: Saul's uncle living at the time of United Monarchy
ner.note: Father of Abner, Saul's army commander. Ner was Saul's grandfather or great-uncle, depending on how the genealogies are fitted together.

nethaneel-5.title: Nethaneel
nethaneel-5.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
nethaneel-5.note: A levite from the united kingdom. 1 Chronicles names him once.

nethaneel-4.title: Nethaneel
nethaneel-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
nethaneel-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

nethaniah-2.title: Nethaniah
nethaniah-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
nethaniah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

netophathite.title: Netophathite
netophathite.note: From Netophah, a small town near Bethlehem. Several of David's mighty men carried the name, and later some Levitical singers did too.

obadiah-5.title: Obadiah
obadiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
obadiah-5.note: One of 12 men called Obadiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

obed-4.title: Obed
obed-4.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
obed-4.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

obed-edom.title: Obed-edom
obed-edom.about: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
obed-edom.note: After Uzzah died, David would not take the ark any further and left it in Obed-edom's house for three months. It brought blessing on his whole household, and that was what got David moving again.

obil.title: Obil
obil.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
obil.note: An Ishmaelite in charge of King David's camels, one of the officials over the royal herds and estates in 1 Chronicles 27:30.

omri-2.title: Omri
omri-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
omri-2.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

ophir.title: Ophir
ophir.note: It was the gold that made Ophir famous across the ancient world. Solomon's ships, sailing with Hiram of Tyre, brought it back in quantity, and the place itself was likely in southern Arabia or along the Red Sea.

ornan.title: Ornan
ornan.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ornan.note: The Jebusite who owned the threshing floor David bought to build an altar and stop the plague, the ground where Solomon's temple later stood. Ornan offered it for nothing, and David insisted on paying. He is also called Araunah.

othni.title: Othni
othni.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
othni.note: A gatekeeper's son. His father was Shemaiah, and the family kept the temple gates in David's reign.

othniel.title: Othniel
othniel.note: Caleb's younger relative, who won Caleb's daughter Achsah by taking a Canaanite city. He became Israel's first judge and broke eight years of oppression under a Mesopotamian king.

parbar.title: Parbar
parbar.note: It is a place on the temple grounds, not a person, on the west side, probably a colonnade or open court. Gatekeepers were posted there.

pedaiah-2.title: Pedaiah
pedaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
pedaiah-2.note: One of 7 men called Pedaiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

pelonite.title: Pelonite
pelonite.about: Warriors from or of Pelon or Palet(?)
pelonite.note: Two of David's mighty men, Helez and Ahijah, carry this label. Where it points is unclear, and it may just be another spelling of Paltite.

perez.title: Perez
perez.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
perez.note: Judah's son by Tamar. He pushed out ahead of his twin Zerah, though Zerah's hand had already been marked with a scarlet thread as the firstborn. His line runs through Boaz to David.

pethakiah.title: Pethakiah
pethakiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
pethakiah.note: When the priests were divided by lot into their courses, one of them fell to Pethahiah (1 Chronicles 24:16), and nothing more is said.

peulthai.title: Peulthai
peulthai.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
peulthai.note: He was one of Obed-edom's sons, in a family of Levite gatekeepers. The ark of the covenant had rested in that household for three months and brought it blessing.

pirathonite.title: Pirathonite
pirathonite.note: Two men carry the label, both from Pirathon in Ephraim. Abdon son of Hillel judged Israel for eight years and is remembered for his many sons and grandsons. Benaiah was one of David's thirty.

ramathite.title: Ramathite
ramathite.note: It tells you Shimei, David's man over the produce of the royal vineyards, came from Ramah.

rehabiah.title: Rehabiah
rehabiah.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
rehabiah.note: Moses's grandson, through his son Eliezer. Chronicles says Rehabiah's descendants grew very many.

rephael.title: Rephael
rephael.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
rephael.note: The sons of Shemaiah, a Korahite gatekeeper, were marked for their "strength for service," and Rephael was one of them.

romamti-ezer.title: Romamti-ezer
romamti-ezer.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
romamti-ezer.note: He was a son of Heman, David's seer, set apart with his brothers for music in the temple. When the lots were cast, the twenty-fourth of the twenty-four courses fell to him.

sacar.title: Sacar
sacar.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
sacar.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the united kingdom.

samuel.title: Samuel
samuel.about: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
samuel.note: Hannah prayed for a son and gave him to the Lord before he was born. He grew up to be the last of the judges and the first great prophet. Israel's first two kings were both anointed by him.

saul.title: Saul
saul.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
saul.note: Israel's first king, found while he was out looking for his father's lost donkeys and anointed by Samuel in private before the tribes confirmed him.

semachiah.title: Semachiah
semachiah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
semachiah.note: A Korahite Levite, son of Shemaiah, put on the gatekeeping for the tabernacle stores under David.

seorim.title: Seorim
seorim.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
seorim.note: Head of the fourth of the twenty-four priestly divisions David set up so the priests could take turns at the temple.

shalleketh.title: Shalleketh
shalleketh.note: Not a person. It was a gate on the west side of the temple, on the causeway going up, and the gatekeepers Shuppim and Hosah were put in charge of it.

shamhuth.title: Shamhuth
shamhuth.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shamhuth.note: Commander of the fifth division of David's army, which served one month each year.

shamir-2.title: Shamir
shamir-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shamir-2.note: One of 3 men called Shamir. This one is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

shaphat-2.title: Shaphat
shaphat-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shaphat-2.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

sharonite.title: Sharonite
sharonite.note: Shitrai the Sharonite looked after David's herds out on the plain of Sharon, the good grazing land on the coast between Joppa and Mount Carmel.

shebuel-2.title: Shebuel
shebuel-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shebuel-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

shebuel.title: Shebuel
shebuel.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shebuel.note: Moses's descendant through Gershom. Under David's arrangement of the Levites he was put over the treasuries.

shecaniah-3.title: Shecaniah
shecaniah-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shecaniah-3.note: One of 7 men called Shecaniah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

shelemiah.title: Shelemiah
shelemiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shelemiah.note: The name of a gatekeeper in 1 Chronicles 26:14. In Jeremiah 37:3 and 38:1 it belongs to the father of an official the king sent to the prophet.

shelomith-2.title: Shelomith
shelomith-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shelomith-2.note: A levite from the wilderness years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

shelomith-3.title: Shelomith
shelomith-3.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shelomith-3.note: One of 5 men called Shelomith. This one is a Levite from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

shelomith-7.title: Shelomith
shelomith-7.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shelomith-7.note: A marginal spelling; the main text reads Shelomoth. He is a Levite over the dedicated treasures.

shelomith.title: Shelomith
shelomith.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shelomith.note: Leviticus 24:11 names her as the mother of the man who was executed for blasphemy. The name turns up again for several other women and Levites in the genealogies.

shemaiah-3.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-3.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
shemaiah-3.note: A Levite of the united monarchy, in the gatekeeper lists of 1 Chronicles 26:4–7, whose sons are called men of strength.

shemaiah-7.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-7.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shemaiah-7.note: One of 26 men called Shemaiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles. The verse is 1 Chronicles 24:6.

shephatiah-5.title: Shephatiah
shephatiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shephatiah-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

shimeah-5.title: Shimeah
shimeah-5.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimeah-5.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him twice.

shimeah-2.title: Shimeah
shimeah-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shimeah-2.note: Exodus and 2 other books name him 5 times, and he is a Levite from the wilderness years.

shimeah-9.title: Shimeah
shimeah-9.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimeah-9.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him. The verse is 1 Chronicles 27:27.

shimeah-8.title: Shimeah
shimeah-8.about: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
shimeah-8.note: One of 17 men called Shimeah. This one is a man from the united kingdom, named once in 1 Chronicles.

shimri-2.title: Shimri
shimri-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimri-2.note: One of 4 men called Shimri. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

shiphmite.title: Shiphmite
shiphmite.note: Zabdi the Shiphmite looked after David's vineyards and the wine stores. He came from Shepham, and nobody now knows where that was.

shitrai.title: Shitrai
shitrai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shitrai.note: Shitrai the Sharonite looked after King David's cattle out on the plain of Sharon.

shoham.title: Shoham
shoham.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shoham.note: A Merarite Levite, son of Jaaziah, in the Levite divisions David set up for the temple.

shuppim-2.title: Shuppim
shuppim-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shuppim-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

sibbecai.title: Sibbecai
sibbecai.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
sibbecai.note: He killed a Philistine giant from the same line as Goliath, and he is listed with David's mighty warriors.

solomon.title: Solomon
solomon.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
solomon.note: David and Bathsheba's son, and Israel's third king. He was rushed onto the throne after his half-brother Adonijah tried to take it while David lay dying. Early on he asked God for wisdom.

tebaliah.title: Tebaliah
tebaliah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
tebaliah.note: Hosah's third son, a Levite of Merari's family who kept the temple gates.

tekoite.title: Tekoite
tekoite.note: Someone from Tekoa, the hometown of Amos. The wise woman Joab sent to David about Absalom was a Tekoite, and so were at least two of David's mighty men.

uzziah-2.title: Uzziah
uzziah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
uzziah-2.note: One of 5 men called Uzziah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

uzziel.title: Uzziel
uzziel.about: Aaron's uncle living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
uzziel.note: Kohath's son, and Aaron's uncle. His descendants had their own duties at the tabernacle.

uzziel-2.title: Uzziel
uzziel-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
uzziel-2.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

uzzielites.title: Uzzielites
uzzielites.about: Aaron's uncle living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
uzzielites.note: The Levitical clan from Uzziel, one of the four Kohathite families. Under David some of them kept the temple treasuries.

zabdi-2.title: Zabdi
zabdi-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zabdi-2.note: One of 3 men called Zabdi. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

zabdiel.title: Zabdiel
zabdiel.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
zabdiel.note: His son Jashobeam commanded a division of David's army.

zaccur.title: Zaccur
zaccur.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zaccur.note: A Levite musician in 1 Chronicles 25, drawn by lot for his turn of service.

zaccur-2.title: Zaccur
zaccur-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zaccur-2.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

zachariah-5.title: Zachariah
zachariah-5.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zachariah-5.note: One of 29 men called Zachariah. This one is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

zachariah-6.title: Zachariah
zachariah-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zachariah-6.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

zachariah-7.title: Zachariah
zachariah-7.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zachariah-7.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once. The verse is 1 Chronicles 27:21.

zachariah.title: Zachariah
zachariah.about: Singer living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah.note: He was a singer and gatekeeper in Chronicles, one of those who played when the ark came up to Jerusalem.

zadok.title: Zadok
zadok.about: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
zadok.note: The priest who stayed with David through Absalom's rebellion. He would have carried the ark out with the king, and David sent it back. Zadok anointed Solomon, and when Abiathar backed Adonijah and was sent away, Zadok was left as the only high priest.

zarchite.title: Zarchite
zarchite.about: Judah's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zarchite.note: A descendant of Zerah. It shows up in the census lists and the rosters in Chronicles and never attaches to anyone well known.

zebadiah-2.title: Zebadiah
zebadiah-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zebadiah-2.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

zebadiah-3.title: Zebadiah
zebadiah-3.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
zebadiah-3.note: A man from the united kingdom. 1 Chronicles names him once.

zebulun.title: Zebulun
zebulun.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
zebulun.note: Jacob's tenth son and Leah's last. His tribe's land ran up to the Sea of Galilee, and Isaiah names it with Naphtali as the place where a light would dawn, which Matthew applies to Jesus in Galilee.

zeri.title: Zeri
zeri.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
zeri.note: One of Jeduthun's sons, set by David to prophesy with instruments. He is probably the Izri of 1 Chronicles 25:11.

zeruiah.title: Zeruiah
zeruiah.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
zeruiah.note: David's sister, the mother of Joab, Abishai and Asahel. David said the sons of Zeruiah were too much for him.

zetham.title: Zetham
zetham.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zetham.note: A Levite of Ladan's family, one of those David set over the temple treasuries.

zichri.title: Zichri
zichri.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zichri.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

zichri-2.title: Zichri
zichri-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zichri-2.note: One of 12 men called Zichri. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles. The verse is 1 Chronicles 27:16.

zina.title: Zina
zina.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zina.note: A Gershonite Levite, Shimei's son, one of the family heads David organized for the temple. The next verse calls him Zizah.

zizah.title: Zizah
zizah.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zizah.note: The same Gershonite Levite as Zina a verse earlier, by the look of it, Shimei's son in David's list of family heads.
